qualification.details: Technical Manager (Electrical & Electronics): Masters in Electrical / Electronics from any AICTE approved Institution with at least 07 years' experience in any steel plant in Energy, Power systems, Maintenance & Training. Technical Assistant to Director: Engineering Graduate (preferably Mechanical/ Metallurgy / Electronics) from AICTE approved Institution with minimum 02 years of experience in Iron and Steel industry. Assistant (P&A): Graduate. Minimum experience -03-05 years in P&A related area, drafting, good communication skills, knowledge of MS Office, Excel etc. Assistant (Technical Division): Diploma in Engineering/B.SC Graduate. Minimum experience -Proficiency in MS office, good communication skills, documentation, data entry, report preparation and office coordination. Minimum one-year post-qualification experience. Typing Speed- 40 words per minute on computer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NISST Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: nisst.org. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NISST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for NISST Recruitment 2026 is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NISST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for various posts including Technical Manager, Technical Assistant, and Assistant in the NISST Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Assistant (Technical Division) post?
faq.answer: For the Assistant (Technical Division) post, candidates need to have a Diploma in Engineering or be a B.SC Graduate with at least one year of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Technical Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Manager post is 45 years. For other posts, the maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for NISST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for NISST Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the highest salary offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The highest salary offered is up to Rs. 1,25,000/- per month for the Technical Manager (Electrical & Electronics) post.

faq.question: Q7. Does NISST offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PWD candidates as per the Government of India's rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the experience required for the Technical Assistant to Director post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 02 years of experience in the Iron and Steel industry is required for the Technical Assistant to Director post.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NISST located?
faq.answer: NISST is located in Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab, with the pincode 147301.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply via email for NISST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: While the primary application mode is offline via post, a copy of the application may also be forwarded through email to [email protected].
